# Sugaring by Steph

> Natural sugaring hair removal in Sylvan Lake, Alberta.

Sugaring by Steph is a local sugaring studio run by Steph. She offers natural, gentle hair removal using organic sugar paste made from sugar, lemon, and water. Appointments are by request (no online self-booking calendar yet).

## Contact

- Phone: [587-377-1195](tel:5873771195)
- Email: [hello@sugaringbysteph.ca](mailto:hello@sugaringbysteph.ca)
- Location: Woodland Crescent, Sylvan Lake, AB T4S 1L9
- Hours: Mon–Fri 9am–5pm; weekend hours may vary
- Booking: [Request an appointment](https://sugaringbysteph.ca/contact)
- Payment: Cash or e-transfer only

## Services

- Intimate: Brazilian (from $55), Bikini ($50), Vagacial add-on ($20)
- Body: Underarms, full/half legs, full/half arms, back, stomach
- Face: Upper lip, chin
- Full prices: [Services & pricing](https://sugaringbysteph.ca/services)
